description: Secure-by-default application firewall for Windows with per-application rules and network controls.
notes: Review only: the official x86/x64 download is an MSI. Scoop's current default MSI handling extracts MSI payloads; it does not execute the installer's custom actions. TinyWall's WiX package invokes TinyWall.exe /install and /uninstall as custom actions and starts the controller. The application also requires a privileged Windows service to manage Windows Filtering Platform rules.

The WiX source uses a wildcard Product Id, so the MSI ProductCode is generated for each build. The legacy Scoop msi manifest property is deprecated and requires a product code; do not replace it with installer, which is intended for non-MSI installers.

A supported elevated install, update, and uninstall lifecycle has not been established, and the SHA-256 of the current 3.6.1 MSI has not been verified. Keep this manifest outside bucket/ until both are resolved.
After installation, TinyWall blocks most network communication by default. Do not install over a remote connection; users must configure application whitelisting from the tray menu.
